en: A vintage divided-back postcard. The front shows a colorized street scene with several multi‑storey buildings and horse‑drawn carriages in front. The central building is labeled as the Nádor Hotel. Bare trees line the wide street. On the message side, there is printed Hungarian text "Levelező-Lap" and a Budapest postmark dated August 20, 1908, along with handwritten Hungarian correspondence and address details.
